digest.component_or_area: CI pytest gate configuration and hang guard
propositions: CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags on _build-and-test.yml's shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini changes because pytest-timeout precedence is CLI > ini and CI workflows execute from trusted main, not the patchset.
A patchset that fixes the timeout budget in pyproject.toml cannot be tested by its own Verified run because the workflow file (carrying the shadowing CLI flags) comes from main, not the patchset.

Removing the --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags from both shared-tier lanes and single-sourcing the budget to [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml allows patchset changes to the ini to be exercised by their own Verified run.

The effective hang budget remains unchanged (300 seconds, thread method) before and after removal because the ini already carries the identical values; only the authority moves from CLI to ini config.
The previously drafted conftest-floor hardening mechanism is rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config at session start read-only with no supported hook point for floor enforcement.
